What Each Option Actually Offers

When it comes to selling stock photos without PayPal, you have several alternatives. Gumroad, for instance, offers a simple e-commerce solution, but its 3.5% + $0.30 per sale transaction fee might be too steep for your business. Lemon Squeezy provides a more comprehensive platform, but its restrictions on restricted countries mean you'll still face problems. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a seamless payment experience with 300+ cryptocurrencies, but its on-chain payment verification process can be complex to set up. Your best bet is to choose a platform that balances simplicity, flexibility, and low fees.

The biggest challenge for creatives in restricted countries is payment processing. NOWPayments, for example, has no KYC requirements, making it a more accessible option. However, its integration with some platforms can be tricky. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, have restrictions on restricted countries, which can lead to payment rejections. A sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these restrictions altogether, giving you complete control over your payment processing.
